label: positive

blockers.detail: the HC stream carries state across compressions: a failed compression sets ctx->dirty, and LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() then fully re-initialises the object via LZ4_initStreamHC(), which MEM_INITs the whole internal state. compress_hc_fuzzer.c allocates a fresh state per input with malloc(LZ4_sizeofStateHC()) and frees it at the end, so the state is never reused and neither the dirty path nor the post-failure reset path is ever exercised

evidence: commit message of the change: 'A failed compression marks the HC state as dirty, and the next LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() fully re-initializes it, using LZ4_initStreamHC(), which also reset favorDecSpeed.'
lib/lz4hc.c (at the change) sets the flag with `if (result <= 0) ctx->dirty = 1;` and guards the full re-init with `if (s->dirty) { LZ4_initStreamHC(...); }`

LZ4_initStreamHC() zeroes the whole internal context: `MEM_INIT(hcstate, 0, sizeof(*hcstate));`, so favorDecSpeed (an int8 parameter previously set by LZ4_favorDecompressionSpeed) is cleared as a side effect

h(M^1) harness ossfuzz/compress_hc_fuzzer.c allocates a new state per input at line 46 (`malloc(LZ4_sizeofStateHC())`) and frees it at line 56; it contains zero occurrences of LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast and zero occurrences of LZ4_favorDecompressionSpeed

measured with gcc 15.2.0 linking lib/lz4.c + lib/lz4hc.c at both revisions: after setting favorDecSpeed=1 and marking the state dirty, LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() leaves favorDecSpeed at 0 before the change and at 1 after it

rationale.zh: lz4 的 HC 流对象携带跨调用的状态：`LZ4HC_compress_generic_internal()` 在压缩失败（`result <= 0`）时把 `ctx->dirty` 置 1，下一次 `LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast()` 看到脏标记就走全量重建，调用 `LZ4_initStreamHC()`；而该函数用 `MEM_INIT(hcstate, 0, sizeof(*hcstate))` 把整个内部上下文清零，顺带把先前由 `LZ4_favorDecompressionSpeed()` 设好的 `favorDecSpeed` 也清成 0。修复只是在重建前后保存/恢复这一个字段。harness 侧的问题是：`compress_hc_fuzzer.c` 每轮输入都 `malloc(LZ4_sizeofStateHC())` 新建一个 state、用完 `free`，**从不复用**，因此既不会产生 dirty 标记，也走不到“失败后复位”这条路径——两条相关分支的覆盖率恒为 0，而编译与运行都完全正常（隐式 / silent）。库的脏状态语义早于本次修复就存在，harness 也从 2024 年写下时就一直复用不了 state，两侧被同一个阻塞挡住，故 `introduced_by_this_change = false`。
rationale.en: An lz4 HC stream object carries state across compressions: LZ4HC_compress_generic_internal() sets ctx->dirty when a compression fails (result <= 0), and the next LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() sees the flag and fully re-initialises the object through LZ4_initStreamHC(), which MEM_INITs the whole internal context and therefore also clears favorDecSpeed (previously set by LZ4_favorDecompressionSpeed). The change saves and restores that one field across the re-init. On the harness side, compress_hc_fuzzer.c allocates a fresh state per input with malloc(LZ4_sizeofStateHC()) and frees it afterwards, so the state is never reused: the dirty flag is never raised and the post-failure reset path is never taken, leaving those branches at zero coverage while the target still compiles and runs normally (silent). The library's dirty-state semantics predate this fix and the harness has never been able to reuse a state since it was written, both blocked by the same cause, hence introduced_by_this_change = false.
